_comment: Generic run config for run_pipeline.py: nothing here is specific to one run. Paths are relative to the repository root. Everything that defines a run is a key in this file, and the command is only --config <file>: for a job, copy this file to jobs/<date>-<name>/run.json and edit the copy. run_id names the run and its folders (out/pipeline/<run_id>/). The clean stage also names the input set (input folder, manifest_sha256, expected_parts); a new input set means new values here. Each of clean, overlap and dedup runs from a settings file (settings only, no paths; the runner fills the paths into <run>/cfg/<stage>.json), or is adopted: {"mode": "adopt", "output": "<folder TSAI returned>"}. Optional keys: "to" (stop after this stage, only the stages up to it are checked), "from" (resume at this stage), stages.clean.only (a list of sample parts, for trials). 'run_pipeline.py --config <file> --plan' prints every folder and command and runs nothing.
_to: optional: clean, overlap, dedup, apply, f2, survivor_loss or shards
_from: optional: resume at this stage; the earlier stages must be recorded in the manifest

clean._manifest: the input set's description. Default: sample_manifest.json in the input folder (TSAI ships it with the sample); set 'manifest' to use another file. manifest_sha256 pins it and is checked before the clean job starts
clean._only_note: rename to 'only' to run the clean job on these parts only

f2._workers: parallel run_f2.py processes, one per pack folder; each needs about 1.1 GB of memory

apply._link: hard-link untouched parts instead of copying them (same file system)

_shards_example._note: rename to 'shards' to add the shard stage after survivor loss; 'packs' limits it to packs with a lane in shards/pack_table.json
